content.title: Complete a successful funding operation for standard_user
content.intent: Prove that a supported authenticated user can initiate and complete funding with a valid amount, increase the targeted balance by the committed amount, and see the operation reflected in transaction history where that surface is exposed.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning for a representative valid funding input and state/flow for the authenticated commit path. Auth-gated and web-form profiles applied because the feature is browser-based and available only after authentication. Risk-gated interaction strength was 3 because money, auth, and data-loss apply; no covering array was needed because this scenario uses one representative allowed combination rather than sweeping multiple independent inputs. Budget: no ceiling set, so this scenario was kept.

parameters.amount_class: valid monetary amount accepted by the live funding surface
parameters.history_expectation: only when transaction/activity history is exposed for the funded account

content.title: Reject a non-numeric funding amount without changing balance or transaction history
content.intent: Prove that a funding attempt with a non-numeric amount is rejected and does not create a false balance change or a completed transaction record.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning for an invalid non-numeric monetary input and negative/error technique because the PRD requires monetary inputs to obey numeric rules and failed financial operations to avoid false committed state. Web-form and auth-gated profiles applied. Risk-gated interaction strength was 3 because money, auth, and data-loss apply; the effective coverage stayed at a single representative invalid partition because only one outcome-changing input family is under test here. Budget: no ceiling set, so this scenario was kept.

content.title: Block unauthenticated access to the funding operation
content.intent: Prove that a user without an authenticated session cannot use protected balance-increase functionality as an authenticated user.
content.technique_notes: Applied auth/permission technique for the protected-operation boundary and negative/error technique for the blocked unauthenticated path. Auth-gated profile applied. Risk-gated interaction strength was 3 because auth applies; no covering array was needed because this path exercises one representative unauthenticated state against one protected operation. Budget: no ceiling set, so this scenario was kept.

parameters.operation: deposit, add-funds, or equivalent balance-increase action if exposed after login

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Highest value because it covers the core supported money-moving path and exercises the most business risk: successful commit, balance update, and conditional history linkage.

[value_score] Second-highest value because invalid amount handling directly protects against false financial state and is the most concrete negative path grounded by the PRD's numeric validation promise.

[value_score] Kept because funding is protected banking functionality and the unauthenticated gate is security-relevant, but it is lower value than the state-integrity paths because it does not exercise a committed balance change.
